title: Kotlin
excerpt: Free sample — Kotlin intermediate course. Chapter 1 begins: "Kotlin on the JVM".
objectives: Explain the core ideas behind JVM and val/var.
Write and run working Kotlin code that uses JVM, val/var, REPL.
Recognise and avoid the common pitfalls associated with interop.
notes: Note — Kotlin on the JVM: JVM / val/var / REPL / interop are the heart of this chapter. Read the sample, then type it yourself.
Good practice: keep every example short and runnable; add a comment that records the expected output exactly.
International standard: every topic points to its section in the appendix and lists revisable key terms at the end.
